# BACKPANEL — Auto Back-Panel Advertising

> BACKPANEL is Gujarat's only RTO-certified auto-rickshaw back-panel advertising network for startups and small businesses.

## What We Do

We put your brand on the back of auto-rickshaws in your neighbourhood. RTO-certified, eco-vinyl, all-inclusive. The driver behind you stares at it at a red light. Then we film it so LinkedIn sees it too.

## Service Area

Currently live across Gujarat: Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Surat, Vadodara, and surrounding areas.

## Pricing

All-inclusive monthly rates (print, install, RTO sign-off, ad tax, GPS proof, eco-vinyl, founder video):

- **Starter**: ₹15,000–20,000/month for 10 autos
- **Neighbourhood**: ₹35,000–45,000/month for 25 autos (most popular)
- **Saturation**: ₹80,000–1,20,000/month for 50+ autos

Minimum: 10 autos, 3-month campaign.

## CPM Math

CPM = tier price ÷ (autos × 10,000 × 30 ÷ 1,000). The 10,000 is the transit-OOH benchmark for impressions per auto per day (honest range: 8,000–12,000). At benchmark, CPM = per-auto monthly rate ÷ 300. Result: approximately ₹5–8 per 1,000 eyeballs, all-in.

## Compliance

- Back-panel only (no hood stickers, no LED, no moving displays)
- RTO + municipal sign-off per auto, per city
- Eco-vinyl (biodegradable, non-PVC)
- 75% ad-area rule observed
- NOC carried on board, ad tax paid
- Third-party liability insurance: ₹5L–₹1Cr per campaign
- AI-created artwork labelled per ASCI 2026 draft

## Proof

GPS-tagged photos of every auto, route maps, and a clean link (bp.in/yourbrand). Billing rule: if an auto isn't on the road, it isn't on your invoice.
